feeds.title: Southern Productions Blog
feeds.description: Southern Productions Weddings + Events is a Mississippi based Wedding Planner and Florist. Serving joy-filled couples, Terrica executes each detail so that her couples can focus on what matters most. She is also an accomplished educator, helping fellow Wedding Planners to grow their businesses.focus on what matters most.

feeds.title: Katelyn Anne Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am Katelyn. I have been a wedding photographer for almost 7 years and have captured over 120 wedding days. Building relationships with my couples and getting to tell their stories through the images reflects throughout my blog.

feeds.title: Lindsay Ott Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lindsay, a fine art wedding photographer capturing classic, romantic and lighthearted images documenting your love story to last a lifetime.

feeds.title: Taylor Square Photography » Wedding
feeds.description: This section of the blog features posts on weddings and engagements. Ann-Marie is the owner of Taylor Square. She loves to capture fleeting moments of emotion in a love story from start to finish.

feeds.title: Kayce Stork Weddings Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kayce. I'm a wedding photographer, daughter, sister, aunt, and cat mom. I enjoy writing here on our online journal and sharing the knowledge that I've learned over the years in the wedding industry with not only my couples, but anyone who want an extra hand to hold during this amazing, yet busy season of life!

feeds.title: Refuge Photography Blog
feeds.description: We're Anna and Ryan, husband and wife destination wedding photography team. We aim to create relationships that last far after your wedding day!

feeds.title: Amelia Catherine & Co
feeds.description: I'm Amelia and I specialize in wedding & lifestyle photography, event planning, floral styling, wedding planning and more.

feeds.title: Jessie Newton Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, friend! I'm Jessie - a southerner with champagne taste and I love documenting wedding experiences for lovers.

feeds.title: Annie Elise Photography Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Annie. My blog is a collection of photographs that tell the stories of couples in love and a place to find engagement and wedding day tips.

feeds.title: Pioneer Productions Blog
feeds.description: Follow along on RD & Ashley's Filmmaking Journey in Mississippi and beyond as they shoot wedding videos, engagement sessions, film documentaries and all of the adventures in-between.

feeds.title: Memories By Meghan Blog
feeds.description: My name is Megan. Wedding photography is my full-time career and as of 2020 I have photographed over 100+ weddings and I can't wait to experience more.

feeds.title: Lisa Tilley Photography
feeds.description: Lisa Tilley Newman is a Boston and Mississippi Gulf Coast-based wedding and event photographer who is available throughout New England and the Gulf Coast.

feeds.title: Captured By Coriss Blog
feeds.description: I am Coriss. I'm a published Mississippi wedding & lifestyle photographer. My photography style can be described as romantic, classic and timeless. I absolutely love photographing couples who are in love and providing memories that can be shared from generation to generation.
